summary: Named only on a 2016 Georgia tower list (Early County, code gfc-207); absent from NHLR's Georgia register, and no source found describes the tower.

evidence.supports: List row: Rowena Lookout Tower at 31.34712, -84.71381 in Early County, code gfc-207
Source is a list titled Georgia lookout towers
The list carries a revision stamp of 22 March 2016
The list's note says gfc-nnn codes come from an older Georgia Forestry Commission (GFC) list that described 203 towers
evidence.quote: an older GFC list described the locations of 203 towers (gfc-nnn).

evidence.supports: NHLR's Georgia register counts 29 registered lookouts
evidence.quote: There are 29 lookouts registered in Georgia.

evidence.supports: The Early County Fire Tower in Blakely is listed in the Town of Blakely
The Early County Fire Tower has its own coordinates, N 31.365800, W 084.941530
The Early County Fire Tower was constructed by the Georgia Forestry Commission in 1952 and staffed until 1987
evidence.quote: was constructed by the Georgia Forestry Commission in 1952 and staffed until 1987

corrections.proposed: gfc-207 (the list's note says gfc-nnn codes come from an older GFC list of 203 towers)
corrections.why: The list gives the code as gfc-207. The label GFC US 207 does not appear in the source.

notes_for_editor: Only one source names this tower: the tnlandforms Georgia list (2016 revision). It gives name, county, coordinates and the gfc-207 code, but no date, height, status, builder or access. The list's unlabelled number 242 is probably elevation in feet; it is not used in the story. Not in the NHLR Georgia register. The NHLR Early County Fire Tower in Blakely is a different registered structure, roughly 22 km away by the two sets of coordinates; do not merge the records. Two WebSearch queries, a combined FFLA chapter-report search, and Wikipedia pages (Rowena, Georgia; the Early County NRHP list) found nothing about this tower. Status and access are unknown and left out. The story is short on purpose, since no source supports more.
